title: Ornette Coleman, Ed Blackwell and avant-garde in New Orleans
summary: The interviewer lectures on Ornette Coleman's stay in New Orleans, Ed Blackwell's brass band drumming roots, and introduces Allen Toussaint and rhythm and blues.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
